decisions.reason: The candidate already has a message-143 MODIFY recording the analogous Small Block interval, counted sale types, and primary-mint pool funding.
The message-143 FAQ Event already records the Big Block interval, counted sale types, and ongoing pool-funding copy.
Counting primary and secondary sales toward prize draws does not change the existing rule that tickets are issued by qualifying code-used primary mints and not by secondary sales.
The candidate's message-143 INTRODUCE already records that primary-sale revenue funds both Small and Big Block pools; no additional allocation change is required.
Changing which sales count toward a draw and fund its pool does not alter the candidate's winner-selection method, eligible ticket population, or VRF properties.

The statement that tickets are received only when someone mints through a holder's code may conflict with random allocation on no-referral mints, but it may also describe only direct referral earnings; removing the earlier rule is not safely entailed.
The sales-counting and pool-funding changes do not alter the separate Small and Big Block counters or their post-draw reset behavior.
Using secondary sales to fund prize pools does not change whether the flat $10 secondary royalty is enforced, and its amount and type are already recorded from message 143.
Draw-counting and pool-funding semantics do not change the Winners-page one-click manual prize-claim flow.
The source change does not modify which ticket counters, badges, or referral-code attributes appear in NFT metadata.
The source change does not alter the Winners page as the prize-winner announcement channel.
Big Block sales counting and pool funding do not change the Transak provider, conversion flow, or supported fiat payment methods.
